# /kickoff
**Purpose:** turn the materials a user dropped in `docs/_intake/` into drafted, human-approved canonical docs — the AI-assisted second half of `syntheprise new` ("AI drafts, humans decide").
**When:** after `syntheprise new <target> --stack <name>` and after the user has filled `docs/_intake/`.
**Inputs:** everything under `docs/_intake/` (requirements-brief, tech-stack-notes, domain-rules-notes, constraints, integrations, `ui-ux/`, plus any raw notes/files/images the user added) and the applied stack pack (`.syntheprise-stack`, `docs/tech-stack.md`, `docs/architecture.md`).
**Files to read first:** `AGENTS.md`, `core-principles.md`, `docs/_intake/README.md`, then all intake materials (use the `read-context` skill).

**Steps:**
1. **Inventory the intake.** List every file present in `docs/_intake/` and note which are filled vs empty/placeholder. Produce a short "inputs used / inputs missing" summary and show it to the user first.
2. **Extract, do not invent.** From the intake only, extract: business goals, personas, features, priorities, out-of-scope, NFRs/constraints, domain rules & formulas, integrations, and UI/UX intent. Mark anything you infer as `Assumption:`; mark anything unconfirmed in the intake as `NEEDS INPUT` — never fill it with a guess.
3. **Draft canonical docs, one at a time, each behind an approval gate** (respect the precedence ladder — requirements hold no architecture; architecture invents no requirements):
   - `requirements.md` (+ `docs/_requirements/` if large) — FR/NFR from the brief & constraints. Reuse `/discovery` → `/requirements`.
   - `project-charter.md` — scope, tier, ownership, success criteria.
   - `docs/domain-rules.md` — only facts explicitly present in `domain-rules-notes.md`.
   - `docs/tech-stack.md` — extend the stack-pack rows with services/libraries named in `tech-stack-notes.md`/`integrations.md`.
   - `docs/architecture.md` — extend the stack scaffold to fit the requirements. Reuse `/architecture-options` for any non-trivial decision; record an ADR (`/adr`).
   - `docs/design-system.md` (+ seed `docs/_ui-ux_design/`) — from `ui-ux/`.
   - seed `docs/traceability.md` — map drafted FRs to planned tests.
4. **Present each draft for explicit approval.** Do not finalize a document until the user approves it. Apply corrections and re-show.
5. **Close the loop.** After approvals, confirm placeholders are resolved, run `./syntheprise gate` (this is now an initialized project — `.syntheprise-project` is present), and report the final "inputs used vs still missing" list so the user knows what to add next.

**Output:** drafted-then-approved `requirements.md`, `project-charter.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/tech-stack.md`, `docs/domain-rules.md`, `docs/design-system.md`, seeded `docs/traceability.md`; an inputs-used/missing report.
**Approval gate:** the user approves each drafted document before it is finalized (AGENTS.md §2.9). Non-trivial architecture decisions get an ADR.
**Forbidden:** inventing business/domain facts not present in `docs/_intake/`; finalizing any doc without approval; putting architecture into requirements or requirements into architecture; editing product code (kickoff drafts governance docs, not features).
